picks.headline: AI that theorizes the world by learning like a child
picks.excerpt: KAIST researchers built a Learning-to-Theorize (L2T) framework, inspired by how children learn, that lets AI discover on its own which rule produced an observed change by composing reusable primitives into executable programs, generalizing far better than prediction-focused models.
picks.rationale: New KAIST method: AI theorizes the rule behind an observed change by composing reusable primitives into executable programs — a fresh discovery paradigm distinct from prediction models and from the earlier toddler-language robot card.

picks.headline: AI scan of DESI survey doubles the known lensed quasars
picks.excerpt: Ohio State astronomers trained AI on simulated lens examples to find seven candidate gravitationally lensed quasars among 800,000 DESI survey objects, roughly doubling the number found in past surveys.
picks.rationale: AI trained on simulated lenses mines 800,000 DESI objects and roughly doubles the known lensed-quasar count — the only astronomy pick, adding domain diversity and a concrete new result.

picks.headline: A neural network measures soil carbon 50x faster
picks.excerpt: Cornell researchers developed a biogeochemistry-informed neural network (BINN) that measures soil carbon 50 times faster than prior methods while preserving accuracy and reducing regional bias, aiding climate-mitigation modeling.
picks.rationale: Cornell's biogeochemistry-informed net cuts soil-carbon measurement time 50x with less regional bias — a climate-science method advance, and distinct from NC State's DNA-binding BINND already published on 07-26.

picks.headline: Clinicians preferred a conversational AI's diagnoses over peers
picks.excerpt: A national-scale Google Research study of SymptomAI, a conversational diagnostic agent, found clinicians preferred the AI's differential-diagnosis suggestions over those of other clinicians in more than half of real-world cases.
picks.rationale: National-scale clinical study where physicians preferred SymptomAI's differential over peers in a majority of real-world cases — high credibility and clear medical-research impact, distinct from prior medical-AI privacy and diffusion cards.
